knowledgeAnswers.rationale: A switch is not isolation; verification is required.
Stored energy can remain after switch-off.
Isolation is the authorised person's task.

practicalCriteria: Identifies energy sources on a sample plant diagram.
Refuses entry in a simulated case where the machine is only switched off.
Records the isolation status and the referral.
passRule: Energy sources identified, entry refused without verification, and status recorded. Observed in a desk exercise. Not an isolation authority.
stopWorkCriteria: Plant entered on a switch-off only
